Nora (CSM): Quick kickoff for CedarBridge onboarding. Goals: connect API -> Redwood hosted endpoint, enable Okta SSO, forward audit logs to their Splunk, and run a 30-day pilot (target 3.5k tokens/day). Who owns what and timeline?
Ben (Solutions Eng): I can own integration playbook + test harness. Suggest 1 week discovery, 2 weeks integration, then pilot.
Ari (Onboard PM): I’ll create a milestone tracker and weekly check-ins. Need CedarBridge IAM contact and Splunk owner.
Sam (Client IT): Sam here. IAM lead is Priyanka, Splunk managed by Ops (Ethan). We can spare 2 dev-days for integration.
Lily (Security): Note CedarBridge processes customer contact data. Before prod we need SOC2 self-attestation and a simple dataflow diagram. I’ll email the checklist.
Nora (CSM): Draft success criteria: 1) Okta SSO passing with test user, 2) generation audit events appear in Splunk, 3) acceptance suite >=95% on seed prompts, 4) pilot 95th pctl latency <350ms, 5) no P0s for 7 days. Flagging renewal risk if integration goes >45 days.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Add output-stability checks for top prompts. Quick curl smoke: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"ping"}'
Ari (Onboard PM): Workshop options: Thu 11:00 PT or Fri 09:00 PT. I’ll block 45m and capture actions.
Sam (Client IT): Thu 11:00 PT works. Priyanka and Ethan will join.
ops-bot: Event created: "CedarBridge Onboarding Workshop" Thu 11:00-11:45 PT. Attendees: Nora, Ben, Ari, Sam, Priyanka, Ethan.
Nora (CSM): Action items: Ben -> playbook draft (3bd), Lily -> security checklist (48h), Ari -> milestone tracker + invites (done).
Ben (Solutions Eng): Will post playbook link here by EOD.
Lily (Security): Checklist sent to Sam. Please attach dataflow diagram when available.
Sam (Client IT): Will provide Okta metadata and Splunk index during the workshop.
Nora (CSM): I’ll run weekly pilot health checks and capture feedback; if early wins, we’ll loop in Renewals mid-pilot. :rocket:
